cohort: 584 patients at a private health service in Vitória, Espírito Santo, Brazil
finding: The vast majority of deliveries in the private sector in this Brazilian cohort were cesarean sections, and while cesarean section was not associated with increased neonatal morbidity, this mode of delivery was associated with reduced maternal morbidity compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with reduced maternal morbidity compared to vaginal delivery, and there was no difference in neonatal morbidity between the two modes of delivery.
gest_age: >37 weeks gestation in 87.49% of the deliveries
